name: Dual Contouring of Signed Distance Data
definition: An algorithm to reconstruct explicit polygonal meshes from discretely sampled Signed Distance Function (SDF) data, designed to recover sharp features. It builds on traditional Dual Contouring of Hermite Data by designing and solving a quadratic optimization problem to decide the optimal placement of the mesh's vertices within each cell of a regular grid. The optimization relies solely on discretely sampled SDF data, without requiring arbitrary access to the function, gradient information, or training on large-scale datasets.
